install.script: if command -v apt &>/dev/null; then curl -sL 'https://install.speedtest.net/app/cli/ookla-speedtest-1.2.0-linux-$(uname -m).tgz' | tar xzf - -C /usr/local/bin && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/speedtest; else echo 'apt not available, install manually'; fi

serverId.description: Optional server ID to pin tests
